categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet rescan implementation in src/wallet/scan.cpp.
categories.rationale: Parallelizes BIP 157/158 compact block filter evaluation across worker threads, yielding major wallet rescan speedups. Benchmarks show runtime dropping from 272 seconds down to 25–38 seconds for 200,000 blocks, verified by multiple reviewers observing 3x to 6x speedups.
